needs.what: mana_spent_trigger must also fire when the tagged mana pays the cost of a non-mana activated ability, binding that ability on the stack as `subject` so the rider can `copy_ability` it (and `copy_spell` it with `new_targets` when it paid for a spell)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_spent_trigger is spell-only: costs.pay_mana queues the rider via _queue_spend_triggers only when record_colors_on is set, which only the spell-cast paths (game.py cast, ops_cards cast) pass; an activated ability's mana payment never checks spend tags, so the 'or activate an ability' half would silently do nothing. The rider also has no way to branch between copy_spell and copy_ability on what `subject` is
